query: I need a map of what this firmware does, feature by feature.
setup: ESP-IDF project: main/ with FreeRTOS tasks created via xTaskCreate, a serial command parser dispatching on string commands in main/console.c, and MQTT topic subscriptions in main/mqtt.c
Compile-time feature switches in sdkconfig (CONFIG_APP_FEATURE_OTA=y, CONFIG_APP_FEATURE_BLE=n) referenced through #ifdef in several files
No dependency extraction tool is available for C in this repository
expected_behavior: Recognises the embedded stack and uses task, command, and event (topic subscription) as entrypoint kinds instead of looking for HTTP routes or screens
Falls back to grep for xTaskCreate, command table entries, and subscribe calls, and tags trace results as INFERRED where it followed #include chains instead of a dependency graph
Lists the two Kconfig switches as compile-time flags in the Flags section with provider `kconfig` and their current values
Writes docs/feature-map.md with the same template as for web projects, with layers named after the detected folder roles rather than forcing FSD names
Keeps the overview flowchart under 40 nodes, splitting into per-capability flowcharts if needed
States explicitly which parts of the map are INFERRED and asks the user to confirm those in a single question round
